name: textarea
title: Textarea
summary: A multiline text field that grows with its text.
description: A multiline text field that grows with its text: a comment, a description, a commit message. It is Input's multiline field (72px minimum; the shared control's sizes, looks, rings, hover and motion, through the input recipe) on Ark UI's Field.Textarea with autoresize. A max-height class caps the growth; past it the text scrolls. Inside a Field it is wired to the label, helper and error.

anatomy.description: The <textarea> itself (class and style land on it): 72px minimum, then as tall as its text; dir="auto" so the text keeps its own direction while the alignment follows the page.

value.description: Controlled: value with onChange. Uncontrolled: defaultValue.

size.description: The shared control's sizes (`lib/control.ts`): text and padding of xs, sm, md, lg (12 · 12 · 13 · 14px; 6 · 8 · 10 · 12px); the block padding centres one line in the size's height. Every size starts at 72px.

variant.description: The shared control's looks (`lib/control.ts`), at every size. outline: the form field (field colour, hairline). subtle: the inspector (inset grey, no edge). ghost: nothing until touched. Focused, open and invalid look the same in every variant.

invalid.description: The red ring (aria-invalid). Inside a Field, the Field's invalid.

autoResize.description: Grow with the text (no resize handle). false: a fixed 72px field with a vertical resize handle.

rows.description: Starting height in lines, when taller than 72px.

keyboard: Standard text editing; Enter adds a line; Tab moves on
notes: Needs a name: a Field label or an aria-label.
Text is 16px on touch devices so iOS does not zoom the page on focus.
Its height follows the text; nothing moves on first paint (a long first value is sized before it).

motion: the Input's: focus and invalid rings over duration.base; the hover fill over duration.fast (pointer only)
growing is instant: the height follows each keystroke, never animated
